source_edition: Ptolemy Tetrabiblos Book IV, Loeb English public-domain reproduction, three LacusCurtius HTML segments

locators: IV.3 Of the Fortune of Dignity
IV.4 Of the Quality of Action
source_pages.scope: natal judgements on wealth/status/vocation and occupational dispositions

locators: IV.9 Of the Quality of Death
IV.10 Of the Division of Times
source_pages.scope: natal travel/mortality/timing method; mortality is not ordinary personality measurement

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy assigns calculation of material acquisitions, wealth and losses to the Lot of Fortune and related planetary relations.
domains.measurement_note: V7 G20 hypothetical spending preferences are not an individual's actual long-term financial history.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy uses luminaries, attendant planets and angles for predictions of honor, rank and public dignity.
domains.measurement_note: V7 STATUS asks how praise feels, not one's actual status over time.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy describes occupations/quality of action, including teaching, commerce, medicine, skilled trades, interpreting dreams, ritual occupations and arts.
domains.measurement_note: This is occupational history/identity. Explicitly includes divination as occupation, but not measurable awe frequency.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy discusses marital timing, number of unions and attributed spouse qualities.
domains.measurement_note: V7 romantic attraction and closeness scenarios cannot establish actual marital timelines; respect partner privacy.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy treats children and offspring outcomes as a distinct natal topic.
domains.measurement_note: Do not presume parenthood, fertility or preferences; do not infer health or give reproductive advice.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy distinguishes durable mutual affinity and hostility from occasional acquaintance or quarrels.
domains.measurement_note: V7 asks anticipated friendship conduct; real time-linked relationship outcomes and shared charts are not measured.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy gives a natal interpretation of journeys and foreign travel with related circumstances.
domains.measurement_note: The V7 weekend-trip coordination scene is not travel history.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy discusses character of death as a natal life-event claim.
domains.measurement_note: Historical interpretation only; do not insert mortality predictions into psychological survey or clinical advice.

domains.claim_summary: Ptolemy assigns temporal periods and directions to different life-domain events.
domains.measurement_note: Changes in hypothetical choice over life stages are not time-stamped real-world events.

scope_control.what_is_directly_attested: Sections IV.2–IV.10 explicitly treat external natal life domains; some specify conditional planet/angle/lot methods.
scope_control.what_is_not_supported: The mere existence of a traditional life domain does not demonstrate accurate natal prediction or a respondent's actual future events.
scope_control.survey_boundary: All current V7 scenarios and participant answers remain untouched. A voluntary factual-life-history research module would be distinct from the psychological questionnaire.
scope_control.reduced_astrohd_boundary: No Lilly/AstroHD reduced model rule is added or retrofitted from the owner's answers.
scope_control.noncompulsory: Do not force marriage, parenthood, health, death or other sensitive histories; retain absence/unknown without negative scoring.
scope_control.next_source_audit: Continue original natal rule-level extraction in Lilly Book III and independent Hellenistic/Jyotish sources; separate source-domain catalogue from prospective scoring and historical source-error checks.
